AtTenTris-ToMe blobs · how 200 cells merge, and where each move looks

Move probabilities (click a row to show its attention)

Where the selected move looked: final tokens, mean of 4 heads

No rule tokenizer: the board enters as one sky token, solid blocks and single cells, plus 7 piece tokens. After attention in each layer, the most similar 4-adjacent blobs merge (the merge schedule: the share of board tokens merged after layers 1–4), so every blob is a connected region; candidates then cross-attend to the final blobs. The model was trained with one schedule; the others are the same weights merging harder at inference (no retraining). Positions tagged game at merge … come from games played at that schedule, labelled afterwards by the teacher. Layer views colour each blob (darker = filled cells, lighter = empty cells) with its outline. Attention paints the selected move's cross-attention through the final blobs, divided by blob size so a big sky blob and a 3-cell gap compare fairly. Dashed outline: the teacher's move; blue: the selected move (the model's top pick by default). Hover a row of the token list to outline that blob in pink. Keys: ← →.
